rows.grounds: indeclinable indicating sequence after the preceding practice
compound referring to the center of command; object of leading
absolutive expressing prior action of leading
fused form containing optative of bhāvay and iṣṭa-devatām as object; internal sandhi noted but token kept whole

items.question: What contemplative act follows leading awareness to the command center?
premises: The preceding practice establishes unity through mantra and mind.
Awareness is then led to the command-city.
The chosen deity becomes the object of contemplation.
items.inference: After establishing unity and leading awareness to the command center, one should contemplate the chosen deity.
uncertainties: The precise locus intended by ājñāpurīṃ is not explicitly defined in this verse.
items.plain_english: Then, having led awareness to the command center, one should contemplate the chosen deity.
